bossDialogue.state: combat clock paused; attack/evade controls hidden; input routed only to dialogue
rules: Finalize dialogue text with the story owner; no new hidden lore or tragedy in UI copy.
Stop transient hit-flash and damage-number presentation before the dialogue idle composition. Keep gameplay rewards/state unchanged.
Hide below-actor HP/name while the dialogue panel covers their region; restore on return to combat.
No typewriter wait is required to understand or skip dialogue. No automatic text advance.
The skip button sits in the empty right margin below the action silhouette; do not overlay the boss face.
On resuming combat preserve the current full cue/timing rules; do not reinterpret dialogue as a new beat.
